name: Sepulchrine-Corrie

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: An atom-forged theocracy that believes the planet is a sealed reliquary, and forbids its opening.

description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by an ancient meteor crater, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Their beacons answer incoming ships in a hundred borrowed languages.
Instruments disagree about the temporal distortion zone: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
